description: Scores a company's Revenue Readiness Index (0–100) from its operating metrics — stage-fit, confidence, NRR / CAC-payback / pipeline-coverage, and the #1 growth constraint. Use it to screen a target or assess a portfolio company. Pass the metrics you have; more metrics = higher confidence.

companyName.description: Optional label for the company being assessed.

metrics.description: Operating metrics (any subset): arr, mrr, momGrowth or yoyGrowth (%), netRevenueRetention (%), grossMargin (%), monthlyChurn (%), cac, ltv, burnMultiple, customerCount, pipelineValue, salesCycleDays. Percentages as numbers (110 = 110%; 1.1 is read as 110% for retention and margin). The more provided, the higher the confidence.

name: assess_company_readiness
